SUPPORT.FAQ1_Q: How do I change my flight date?
SUPPORT.FAQ1_A: You can change your flight date by navigating to Manage Bookings inside the app, selecting your active flight, and clicking Change flight date. Standard airline change fees and fare differences may apply.
SUPPORT.FAQ2_Q: What is Peek AI Travel Discovery?
SUPPORT.FAQ2_A: Peek AI Travel Discovery is our advanced recommendation engine. You can naturally describe what kind of trip you want (e.g. "I want a quiet beach with clear water in October...") and our AI will search, build, and suggest the perfect custom itinerary for you instantly.
SUPPORT.FAQ3_Q: How long do refunds take to process?
SUPPORT.FAQ3_A: Most refunds are reviewed within 24 hours. Depending on your payment provider, the refunded credit will typically reflect on your bank or credit card statement within 5 to 10 business days.
SUPPORT.CONCIERGE_DESC: Need specialized help? Our human experts are available 24/7 for complex itinerary changes.

LEGAL.HELP_DESC: Contact our support team for any legal questions.
LEGAL.PRIVACY_P1: At Peek, your privacy is paramount. We collect information to provide, personalize, and improve our services, including search queries, booking selections, and communication details.
LEGAL.PRIVACY_P2: We use the collected information to facilitate intelligent flight search, process your requests, authenticate accounts, analyze platform performance, and customize your travel discoveries.
LEGAL.AGE: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and book travel.
LEGAL.NO_SCRAPE: You agree not to use automated systems or software to extract data from the Services for commercial purposes ("screen scraping").
LEGAL.COMPLY: You will comply with all applicable local, state, and international laws regarding travel and commerce.
LEGAL.COOKIES_P1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you browse websites. They help remember configurations, analyze activity, and customize content to give you an optimal flight searching experience.
LEGAL.COOKIES_P2: You can control or disable cookies through your browser preferences. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the performance and availability of certain interactive features inside Peek.
LEGAL.AGREEMENT_P1: This User Agreement outlines the contractual relationship between Peek and the individual users of our platform. It governs all searches, booking assistance, and recommendations provided through our AI systems.
LEGAL.AGREEMENT_P2: Our platform is intended solely for personal, non-commercial search and booking of flights, hotels, and custom travel discovery. Any automated crawling or extraction is strictly prohibited under these terms.

Modal.body1: With Flexible Ticket you can reschedule your flight up to 24 hours before departure, paying only the fare difference. The product can be used once for your outbound flight, your returning trip or even both at the same time.
Modal.body2: You can change the date and time of your flights, while keeping the same airline and destination.
Modal.body3: You can reschedule your journey with a phone call up to 24 hours (one day) before departure.
Modal.body4: Your new flight dates need to be chosen within a year of your original booking and your new ticket won't be refundable.
Modal.body5: Flexible Ticket cannot be used to change passenger names, classes or destinations.
Modal.body6: Flexible Ticket can only be purchased when booking your trip.
